args.title: Include the rupee sign in currency symbols processed by parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Enhance the `parseAmount` function to handle amounts with the rupee sign (₹) by including it in the list of removable currency symbols. This prevents rejection of valid amounts and resolves 'The amount is not a number' error for transactions involving rupees.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In `parseAmount` function, only certain currency symbols (€, $, £, ¥) are removed from amounts. The absence of the rupee sign (₹) causes the rejection of amounts containing it, leading to the error 'The amount is not a number'.
